title: WRCC2023_MI_B: Three-class motor imagery dataset (MI-B) of the BCI competition WRCC2023
description: A three-class motor imagery EEG dataset (MI-B) released for the BCI competition at the 2023 World Robot Contest. It contains recordings from 9 participants (7 healthy, 2 stroke patients) imagining left hand, right hand, and feet movements, with 30 cued trials per class. Data were recorded with a 59-channel EEG montage at 1000 Hz and re-released in BIDS format via MOABB.
methods_description: Cue-based offline three-class motor imagery paradigm (left hand, right hand, feet), 90 interleaved trials per subject (30 per class), 4 s trials. EEG was recorded with a Neuracle 64-channel system (59 EEG channels retained) at 1000 Hz with 50 Hz line frequency.
